verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it lets you "watch spend in real time." Receipts and categories are captured "as soon as you swipe," and transactions can be searched by merchant, date, or user alongside department data. That covers same-day visibility and merchant and category context. But no first-party dashboard or report breaking spend down by team, category, and merchant is documented. missing for 10: a documented spend dashboard or report grouped by team/department and category, explicit merchant-level spend breakdowns in the product UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time posting.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land
